def ref_unit(n: int) -> int:
    return abs(n) % 10

def ref_multiply(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return ref_unit(a) * ref_unit(b)

    a=st.integers(min_value=-10000, max_value=10000),

    assert multiply(a, b) == ref_multiply(a, b)
